issues.description: The example usage in the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java) calls a non-existent method farm.feed() (commented at line 20). The problem statement specifies a method named feedAllAnimals() and the reference solution implements public void feedAllAnimals() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java (signature at line 27). This naming mismatch between the starter example and the specified/implemented API can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template example and the API consistent. Either update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (replace farm.feed()), or add a small delegating method in the Farm template: public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); } so the example compiles against the template. Also ensure any other example references use the same method name.
